req.title: Login required for update
req.statement: The system shall redirect anonymous users to /auth/login when they attempt GET /<id>/update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that anonymous users should be redirected to the login page when attempting to access the update endpoint. This behavior ensures that only authenticated users can update posts, maintaining security and data integrity. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct redirection for anonymous users, a negative case to ensure authenticated users can access the endpoint, and a boundary case to test the behavior when the session is cleared.

tests.name: test_anonymous_user_redirected_to_login
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/1/update')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == 'http://localhost/auth/login'

tests.name: test_authenticated_user_access_update
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
response = client.get('/1/update')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert b'Update' in response.data

tests.name: test_session_cleared_redirect_to_login
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
client.get('/auth/logout')
response = client.get('/1/update')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == 'http://localhost/auth/login'
